changes.rationale: PackageEffects no longer exposes unconditional replacement or removal. One compare_exchange_package primitive requires digest expectation comparison and transition to be indivisible, requires mismatch and error to preserve state, and rejects read-then-unconditional-write emulation.

Build derives the exact prior package-output digest from a bounded read and installs the deterministic candidate only through the atomic expected-state transition; a mismatch returns stable InstallConflict without mutating concurrent state.

A failed post-transition verification restores prior bytes or absence only while the installed candidate digest remains current, then byte-reconciles the restoration. Concurrent substitutions are preserved and reported as InstallConflict; effect and reconciliation failures report RollbackFailed.

Injected races cover absent and exact-prior states, mutation before write and rollback, special-file substitution, failed transition, failed verification, failed rollback, non-echo, and idempotent repeat use.

The existing install fixture's PackageSink implements only the changed PackageEffects contract so the full N04 suite compiles against one package-output authority; InstallEffects and install atomicity semantics were not changed.
